'''Shasa ale''' was an [[ale]] available at [[Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] from the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' were to meet an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|dining establishment]] on [[StarForge Station]]. The group were to identify themselves to the [[Unidentified Ithorian (StarForge Station)|agent]] by ordering [[flangth]] and [[ootoowerg]]s with Shasa ale.<ref name="PW" />
